notes: Batch 5 adds workspace navigation to notes, Git status/path diffs/paginated history, terminals with a basic ANSI display, and browser previews through session-owned pinned WSS /tunnel forwarding into a WebView. Binary frame validation, bounded stream queues, credit flow control, URL rewriting, and teardown have service tests. Earlier pairing, conversations, tasks, comments, attachments, and cache features remain. Android is unreleased. Browser previews need device/live-daemon verification; use relative resource URLs and valid HTTPS certificates. Full VT rendering, Tailcat, note editing, video import, model selection, full rich rendering, and remaining iOS features are under development.
